en.headline: More than 3,800 eateries offer discounts for National Day
en.dek: Participating outlets include restaurants, hotels, food courts and market stalls, with deals of up to 30 per cent off and special set menus tied to the 77th anniversary.
body: More than 3,800 food outlets across Hong Kong will offer discounts and special deals around National Day on 1 October to mark the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China.

Catering sector representatives said the number of participating businesses exceeds that of the July 1 Establishment Day promotion. Offers include full-bill discounts of up to 30 per cent, set meals priced at HK$77 or HK$10.1, and special deals at wet markets and food courts. Several hotel restaurants and chain brands are taking part for the first time.

Lawmaker Jonathan Leung of the catering sector said the industry hoped the campaign would encourage residents and visitors to dine out and help promote Hong Kong. Some promotions begin before 1 October and run into early October. Soft-meal discounts for older diners are also available at certain outlets in support of the silver economy.

zh.headline: 逾3800間食肆推國慶優惠 最高全單七折
zh.dek: 參與商戶包括餐廳、酒店、美食廣場及街市檔攤，優惠涵蓋全單折扣及以77周年為主題的套餐，部分活動已於本周起展開。
body: 飲食業界公布，全港超過3800間食肆及商戶將於10月1日國慶日前後推出餐飲優惠，慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年。
參與數目較今年七一回歸紀念日優惠活動為多，涵蓋中西日式餐廳、快餐店、酒店餐廳、美食廣場及街市檔攤。優惠包括全單最高七折、77元或10.1元套餐，以及街市鮮貨特價。部分連鎖集團全日堂食全單七折，亦有商戶提供軟餐折扣方便長者。
飲食界立法會議員梁進表示，業界希望透過活動吸引市民及旅客外出用膳，並推廣香港餐飲。部分優惠已由本周起至10月初陸續展開，市民可留意個別商戶詳情。
